knowledge:
- key_parameters: design=A formula or model matrix specifying the experimental design ;; on_disk=Logical indicating whether to perform calculations on-disk (TRUE) to handle large datasets or in-memory (FALSE) for speed ;; reference_level=The factor level to use as the reference intercept in the model ;; size_factor=Method for calculating size factors (e.g., "ratio" for DESeq2's method) or a numeric vector of pre-calculated size factors ;; group_by=Used inside pseudobulk() with vars() to specify metadata columns for cell aggregation ;; contrast=An algebraic expression of model coefficients or cond() helper specifying the comparison for test_de()
- alternatives: DESeq2=A classical RNA-seq method; prefer glmGamPoi for much faster execution on large single-cell datasets and more reliable overdispersion estimates ;; edgeR=A classical RNA-seq method; prefer glmGamPoi for faster execution and exact overdispersion calculations instead of approximations
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing overdispersed count data (such as RNA-seq or single-cell RNA-seq) to fit linear models, identify marker genes, or perform differential expression testing across conditions.
- pitfalls: cell_level_de_testing=Applying test_de() directly to single-cell data without pseudobulk aggregation leads to underestimation of variance and overly optimistic (false positive) p-values because cells from the same individual are not independent replicates ;; legacy_pseudobulk=Performing pseudobulk aggregation inside test_de() (using the pseudobulk_by argument) is deprecated and computationally wasteful; use the pseudobulk() function first, then fit the model ;; empty_factor_levels=glm_gp() will fail if design variables contain empty factor levels; use droplevels() on metadata before fitting

workflows.name: pseudobulk_differential_expression
workflows.intent: Aggregate single-cell expression data into pseudobulk samples by individual and condition, fit a Gamma-Poisson GLM, and test for differential expression.
input: sce (SingleCellExperiment object containing raw single-cell counts and cell-level metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Aggregate single-cell counts to pseudobulk using pseudobulk() ;; 2. Filter out missing cell types ;; 3. Fit the Gamma-Poisson GLM using glm_gp() ;; 4. Test for differential expression using test_de()
workflows.code:
reduced_sce <- pseudobulk(sce, group_by = vars(ind, condition = stim, cell), 
                          fraction_singlet = mean(multiplets == "singlet"), n_cells = n())
reduced_sce <- reduced_sce[,!is.na(reduced_sce$cell)]
fit <- glm_gp(reduced_sce, design = ~ condition*cell + ind, size_factor = "ratio", verbose = TRUE)
res <- test_de(fit, contrast = cond(cell = "B cells", condition = "stim") - cond(cell = "B cells", condition = "ctrl"))

workflows.name: cell_level_marker_gene_identification
workflows.intent: Fit a Gamma-Poisson GLM directly on cell-level single-cell data to identify marker genes between cell types.
input: sce_subset (SingleCellExperiment object containing cell-level counts and cell-type annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Fit the Gamma-Poisson GLM on cell-level data using glm_gp() ;; 2. Identify marker genes in the control condition using test_de() ;; 3. Identify marker genes in the stimulated condition using test_de() with combined coefficients
workflows.code:
fit <- glm_gp(sce_subset, design = ~ cell + stim +  stim:cell - 1,
              reference_level = "NK cells")
marker_genes <- test_de(fit, `cellCD4 T cells` - `cellB cells`, sort_by = pval)
marker_genes2 <- test_de(fit, (`cellCD4 T cells` + `cellCD4 T cells:stimstim`) - 
                               (`cellB cells` + `cellB cells:stimstim`), 
                        sort_by = pval)
